look: Held-back product demo: the real ng-prism styleguide, lifted from its build, on the dark brand ground with its three soft glows; one developer showing another, captions as a lower third with the brand gradient on the emphasised words, no marketing speak

scenes.name: ng-prism
scenes.desc: Out of the mark's own blurred light the camera pulls back until the prism is sharp; a flare runs through it, the name slides out, the slogan settles below.

scenes.name: Annotate
scenes.desc: The @Showcase block types itself above @Component in button.component.ts; the code below moves down as each line opens.

scenes.name: The styleguide
scenes.desc: The styleguide the decorator produced; the camera moves onto the sidebar, the variant tabs and the button.

scenes.name: Live inputs
scenes.desc: The label is typed into its control and the button follows each key; the variant switches to ghost; a click shows in Events.

scenes.name: States
scenes.desc: The canvas tools open; Hover, Focus visible and Pressed are clicked in turn; the Box Model draws its overlay on the button.

scenes.name: A11y
scenes.desc: On the faint Ghost variant a click on the A11y tab shows its real contrast violation.

scenes.name: API pages
scenes.desc: On the Form Field a click on API opens the page generated from its JSDoc: description, usage, examples.

scenes.name: ng add
scenes.desc: End card: the ng-prism lockup with its sheen and the install command.
